The Company:

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.

We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

About the Role

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team, people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.

This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.

You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.

This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.

  • Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.

  • Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.

  • Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.

  • Collaboration & feedback: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.

This Role Is For You If

  • You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results

  • You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new

  • You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly

  • You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort

  • You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure

  • You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates

  • You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared

Our Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.

  • First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)

  • One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)

  • Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side

This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

Year 1 OTE £35,000 uncapped

Time off & flexibility

  • 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday

  • Work from where works for you: choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in

jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience

 

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

You should apply if:

  • You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

  • You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A bit about you

  • AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

 

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

 

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

 

Salary

We're not publishing a fixed band for this one. We'll build the package around your experience and the scope you bring, so please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc. a Design & AI Task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder.

 

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

jobs.description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it.

  • You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them.

  • Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource.

  • Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven.

  • Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it.

What we're looking for

  • AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal?
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you.

  • You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

jobs.title: Financial Accountant (m/w, 80–100%)
jobs.description:
IN KÜRZE

Du begeisterst dich für Zahlen, legst Wert auf Präzision und möchtest aktiv das Wachstum von FELFEL mitgestalten? Als Financial Accountant (80–100%, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung) in Zürich Wiedikon übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem agilen Finance Team. Hier formst du nicht nur Zahlen, sondern gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens.


DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

  • Führe das Tagesgeschäft inklusive Haupt- und Nebenbücher (Debitoren, Kreditoren, Bank- und Zahlungsabstimmungen) für unsere Schweizer Gesellschaft und unterstütze das Tagesgeschäft unserer US-Gesellschaft.
  • Erstelle Verrechnungen an Kunden und wirke bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen nach Schweizer Recht mit.
  • Pflege und optimiere unser ERP-System (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC), um dessen kontinuierliche Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen.
  • Agiere als Ansprechperson für interne sowie externe Stakeholder bei Fragen zur Rechnungsstellung und Kreditorenbuchhaltung.
  • Wirke an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finanzprozesse mit.
  • Steuere die Kommunikation als Schnittstelle zu externen Partnern wie ERP-Support, Behörden und Lieferanten.
  • Unterstütze bei der Erstellung von MWST-Abrechnungen, Sales and Use Tax Meldungen für unsere US-Gesellschaft sowie bei der jährlichen Steuererklärung.


WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen in einem ähnlichen Umfeld.
  • Abschluss als Eidg. Finanzfachmann/frau im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (oder aktuell in entsprechender Ausbildung).
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC von Vorteil).
  • Leidenschaft für Zahlen, Strukturen und Prozesse in einem agilen Umfeld.
  • Selbstständige, exakte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und Fähigkeit, mit internen sowie externen Partnern professionell zu kommunizieren.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nichtraucher:in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenterminen. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.
  • Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung für die Schweiz oder Schweizer Pass.


WAS WIR BIETEN

  • Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...
  • Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine
  • 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag
  • Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV
  • Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten
  • Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Dutch Speaking
AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

Your Mission

Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence: turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale.

Concretely, you will:

  • Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers.

  • Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end, from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily.

  • Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current.

  • Translate insights into iteration loops in production, by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes.

  • Design and train new recommendation models from scratch when needed, with a focus on scalability, evaluation rigor, and deployability in real-world traffic.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong academic background (MVA, ENS, X, Central…)

  • 2+ years of experience in AI, Agentic Systems, ML / Deep Learning, statistics or NLP

  • Experience prototyping and deploying AI models into production

  • Experience with production systems (APIs, monitoring, optimization)

  • Strong interest in LLMs, recommendation and conversational systems: building agentic pipelines, agent orchestration, fine-tuning

  • Comfortable with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus

Tech Stack

ML/AI (required)

  • Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and/or native SDKs like OpenAI/Anthropic

  • Observability and evaluation for LLM/agent workflows

  • Vector search, scoring, prompting, LLM orchestration

  • Hybrid recommender systems, causal inference, probabilistic models

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • TypeScript

  • Engineering: Docker, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector DBs, PostHog

  • CI/CD

Why Join Us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

Package

Competitive salary disclosed during the interview process.

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Team Lead Website to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

Drive Conversion

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

Playwright, Grafana, connaissance du cloud ou des infrastructures GPU.

Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries successfully complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centres, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

 

Sterling is a fast-growing B2B SaaS technology business. We have recently been acquired by TransPerfect, the world’s largest provider of language and technology solutions for global business, with offices in over 120 cities on six continents.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in both French and English

  • Commercially rigorous — accurate pipeline management, disciplined forecasting

 

Languages

  • French — native or bilingual (essential)

  • English — fluent, business-level (essential)

  • Additional languages a plus

 

Education

  • Degree in **Business, Marketing, Communications, Languages, or a creative discipline** — or equivalent professional experience

jobs.title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (H/F), Paris
jobs.description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Paris).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office option
  • Flexible working hours
  • Fitness subsidy
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

Deine Mission

Als Sales Operations Manager - Memory Solutions (MEM) stellst du sicher, dass unser zukünftiges Vertriebsmodell wirksam, transparent und skalierbar funktioniert. Du übersetzt das definierte strategische Zielbild in ein klares operatives Sales-Vorgehensmodell. Dazu gehören Prozesse, Rollen, Meetings, KPIs, Schnittstellen, Forecasting-Logiken, Deal-Desk-Mechaniken und transparente Steuerungsinstrumente.

jobs.description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
  • 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
  • 30 days paid vacation per year
  • Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
  • Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
  • Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
  • Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
  • Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
  • Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
  • Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
  • Free parking right outside the door
  • Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
  • Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office

Position Overview:

This is a vacancy for a hybrid role based at our coworking office in Paris (9th arrondissement, Opéra). We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender identity. You will be on-site in Paris 2 days per week for close collaboration and alignment; the remaining 3 days can be worked remotely.

We're a small, fast-moving French team backed by a German HQ. We need someone genuinely entrepreneurial who thrives on ownership rather than process, and who is both commercially sharp and technically curious – a strong communicator able to translate technical value into business outcomes.

Ready to make an impact?


You’ll get to take ownership of:

  • Full sales cycle: owning qualification through close on the French market. Typical deals run €33–40k ACV, with occasional enterprise opportunities above €150k.
  • Net-new business in a lean setup: driving new-logo pipeline generation in a 3-person French sales team, where sourcing outside your own network matters as much as closing.
  • Partner-led scaling: building and activating the strategic partner ecosystem (Hardis, Horus, Acelys, CGI, Devoteam) as a lever for sourcing and co-selling – partner-sourced deals count at a 1.2× accelerator toward quota.
  • Technically credible selling: running discovery and value conversations around data integration, EDI and IT/SI architecture, engaging both business and technical stakeholders (IT, architecture, CISO).
  • Cross-functional deal-shaping: working closely with Sales Engineering and Partnerships on complex, multi-stakeholder deals, RFPs and consortia.


We’d love to meet someone with:

  • Proven track record: consistently closing software/SaaS deals with a documented win history – not just pipeline.
  • New-logo generation: a track record of opening new business outside your own existing network, through mapping, partners, events or an installed base.
  • Technical affinity: strong understanding of data, integration and IT system architecture; able to hold your own in a technical discovery conversation.
  • Industry knowledge: domain exposure to logistics, supply chain, retail, manufacturing, automotive or pharma.
  • Scale-up selling: experience in a small / scale-up structure – high autonomy, hands-on, comfortable without heavy sales infrastructure.
  • Partner / channel selling: demonstrated success selling through or with strategic partners and system integrators (co-sell, ecosystem-led growth).
  • Languages: French native or bilingual; professional/fluent English (internal working language; HQ in Germany). 


You can look forward to:

  • No closed territories – this is a meritocracy: the more you win, the more scope you get.
  • Uncapped variable compensation, with quotas designed to be achievable.
  • An AI-equipped sales workflow, including deal coaching and prospecting support.
  • Direct access to the Head of France and to how decisions get made.
  • A coworking office in Paris (Opéra)
  • A personal learning and development budget
  • 30 vacation days per year
  • Up to 20 days of remote work per year from any EU country
  • Opportunity to work flexibly from home

If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply! 

Lobster is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where empathy and respect guide our interactions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
jobs.description:
About H:

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

 

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

 

What you'd be doing

  • Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

  • Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

  • Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

  • Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

  • Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

  • Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

 

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

 

Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

 

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

  • Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

  • Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

  • Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.

  • Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

Stronger still if you have

  • Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.

  • Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.

  • Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.

  • Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.

  • Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.

 

You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

 

How we hire

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

 

Practicalities

Paris posting: Hybrid in Paris. That means 3 office days a week and a London trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a London posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.

jobs.title: Automation Lead
jobs.description:
About us, and our mission

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI.

Position overview

Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities.

  • Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership.

  • In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project.

  • Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds.

  • Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests.

  • Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists.

  • Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step.

  • Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly.

  • Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs.

  • Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management.

In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer.

Key qualifications

Must-have

  • Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience.

  • Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes.

  • Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects.

  • Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting.

  • You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes.

  • Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Nice-to-have

  • You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience.

  • Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work.

  • A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace.

  • Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software.

  • Experience hiring and leading an automation team.

What we offer

  • You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver.

  • Short decision lines and fast execution.

  • An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent / People — 20 minutes

  2. Interview with the Lab Director, hiring manager — 45 minutes, including a 15-minute live mini-case on a small lab process

  3. Technical deep dive with the CTO and the Lab Director

  4. Case study on a real part of our lab: a take-home capped at four hours, then a half day on site with presentation, challenge round, lab walk.

  5. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes

  6. Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered

  7. Founder conversation — 45 minutes

  • Monitor the condition of the demonstration fleet and report anomalies

  • Keep the hardware mission-ready at all times

Administrative Support

  • Prepare authorisation requests and write mission reports

  • Keep tracking tools up to date: backlog, planning, and mission logs

  • Military background or defence sector experience strongly valued: logistics, field support, or operations

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. 

Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail. 

To enable this Kraken now structures itself across 3 key delivery practice groups. Human Design, Org Design and Tech. 

This role sits within the Human Design Team. 

Purpose of the Human Design Lead

The main purpose of the Human Design Lead is to be the single point of accountability for the successful enablement and implementation of culture / ways of working transformation in our clients. Human Design activities align to Global Practices and include:

  • Human enablement

  • Behavioural transformation

  • Leadership Development Programs

  • Coaching

  • Learning

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • New and existing senior clients’ relationships

    • Actively involved in the end to end cycle of new clients’ pursuits, sales and onboarding

    • Responsible for regional client portfolio (expected approx 4 clients)

    • Point of contact for senior client relationships long term

    • C-suite leadership coaching and enablement 

  • Kick-start Human Design discussion with clients

    • Initial sprint setup including leading activities such as

      1. Line of Sight

      2. Culture survey

      3. Exec LDP

    • Liaise with Human Design Global Practice Leads to influence and bring best practice into programs

    • Lead top-down cultural transformation, working with the C-suite and exec layer in organisations

    • Senior cover for Human Design activities throughout migration including ongoing risk monitoring and escalation

  • Cultural stewardship

    • Embody the Kraken ways of working and support the delivery team to do the same (and ensure a consistent experience across the portfolio)

    • Act as the bridge between new clients and best practice success stories

🧠 What you bring to the party:

  • In depth knowledge and expertise in all facets of Human Design necessary to enable transformation (including cultural transformation, leadership development, coaching, learning) 

  • Experience in leading portfolios of major program transformations across different geographies

  • Track record of trust-based partnerships with C-suite and executives

  • Excellent communication skills at storytelling level across different seniorities and cultures

  • Excellent facilitation skills

  • Experience in navigating ambiguity and complexity 

  • Clear understanding of the connection between human, organisation and technology in the context of tech-enabled transformations 

  • Experience of working within the Energy, Utilities and Telco industries is highly desirable 

  • In depth knowledge of leadership and organisation behavioral best practices including concepts such as 

    • Psychological safety

    • Empowerment 

    • Growth mindset 

    • Agile leadership 

    • High performing team

What we’re looking for

  • A systems thinker who is human-led based in Paris, France 

  • We are a kind, friendly, human organisation.

  • Deep understanding of adult learning, behaviour change and organisational psychology.

  • A world-class and experienced leadership development expert.

  • A storyteller who deeply understands the art of facilitation 

  • Proven credibility working with senior leaders and executives.

  • Experience building or scaling leadership or learning practices in complex environments.

  • Calm, confident and playful presence - able to challenge with empathy and clarity.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients.

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an international energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manage the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation.

 

We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Building trusted relationships with client executives and technology stakeholders, including partnering with our product and engineering teams to align on priorities. Serving as the escalation point for client concerns and ensuring both technical challenges and product requirements are effectively managed

  • Defining success criteria and governance for delivering the technical pillar of the program. 

  • Owning the Kraken platform localisation plan to meet client expectations while matching Kraken roadmap

  • Directing internal Kraken software developers contributing to the client program, as well as potential external Partners, on tech platform deliverables to ensure  an overall successful and timely  technology migration.

  • Supporting the client meets their business needs via the delivery of tech. 

  • Understanding the Kraken infrastructure, aligning client direction with the overall goal for the Kraken platform & business. 

  • Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client. 

  • Being an advocate for the Kraken way of delivering tech and supporting the client in shifting their mindset around tech delivery

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity.  You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints.   

  • Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients. 

  • Strong technical aptitude: We are looking for a logical thinker who has strong problem solving skills within an agile working framework. Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. Is an advocate for the continuous deployment approach we take at Kraken and champions building tech iteratively. 

  • Business acumen: Able to understand business goals of both client and Kraken, putting all technology decisions into context to ensure measurable success can be achieved and celebrated.

  • You are based in Paris, France and willing to travel internationally

Experience / Qualifications needed:
