Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls.

Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work.

The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes.

Key responsibilities

Anti-corruption/Sapin II

  • Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure.

  • Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review;

  • Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme,

  • Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams.

  • Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls.

  • Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations.

Economic sanctions and export controls

  • Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes.

  • Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware.

  • Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance.

  • Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements.

  • Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership.

Qualifications and skills

  • Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority.

  • Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls.

  • Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence.

  • Analytical and problem solving skills: Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems.

  • Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner.

  • International mindset: International experience is a plus.

  • Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and compute topics, and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge.

  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

  • Ethical Awareness: Ability to promote an ethical and responsible culture.

jobs.title: Perception and Fusion Engineer
jobs.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role

We're looking for a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer to develop the algorithms that give the largest drone swarm in the world an accurate, shared picture of the battlespace. This is a deep algorithm role for someone who lives in the details of detection, tracking, and estimation, and wants to see their work fly.

What You'll Do

  • Train, tune, and test automatic target recognition and track management systems using the latest advancements in neural networks.

  • Develop multi-sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multi-target tracking) running onboard resource-constrained vehicles.

  • Design distributed fusion approaches that combine tracks across the swarm into a single coherent picture.

  • Rigorously characterize algorithm performance against real-world flight data and simulation.

  • Optimize models and estimators for real-time inference on edge compute.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

  • Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events.

Basic Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience.

  • Demonstrated expertise in estimation theory and multi-target tracking (Kalman/particle filters, JPDA, MHT, random finite sets, or similar).

  • Hands-on deep learning experience (training, evaluation, and deployment of neural networks for detection or classification).

  • Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Go, and/or Python.

  • Track record of taking algorithms from research to deployment on a real system.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications or deployed work in ATR, multi-sensor fusion, or distributed estimation.

  • Experience with EO/IR, radar, or RF sensor processing on aerial platforms.

  • Experience deploying ML models to embedded or edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization).

  • Familiarity with defense sensing and tracking problem domains.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

jobs.description:
Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr.

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil".

En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique.

Activités d'enseignement

  • Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Energie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ;

  • Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du génie civil, des matériaux et du calcul des structures ;

  • Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ;

  • Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ;

  • Piloter une spécialisation en dernière année d’études et proposer des missions de recherche et développement ;

  • Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an.

Activités de recherche

  • Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ;

  • Renforcer la thématique sur les matrices cimentaires bas carbone, en lien avec les propriétés macroscopiques et la durabilité de ces matériaux, et fédérer d’autres chercheurs en faisant le lien avec les aspects modélisation et mécaniques développées au LMGC ;

  • S’intéresser aux méthodes de caractérisation expérimentale des propriétés des matériaux cimentaires de l’état frais et à l’état durci en particulier de la microstructure nécessitant des connaissances en physico-chimie des matrices cimentaires et sur l’adjuvantation ;

  • Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil.

Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique

  • Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ;

  • Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ;

  • Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production.

  • Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques.

https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/Zqr5eBT6ijzic9y


Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des matériaux de construction, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée (Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act.

  • Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées (backdoors) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs.

  • Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles, notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles.

  • Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA.

  • Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé.

  • Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués.

  • Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées.

  • Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche, notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet.

  • Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance,

Activités

  • Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes.

  • Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité, en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites.

  • Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés.

  • Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications.

  • Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré, notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé (Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC).

  • Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information.

  • Étudier l’impact des mécanismes de protection de la vie privée sur les méthodes d’explicabilité, notamment les méthodes fondées sur l’attribution, et identifier des stratégies permettant de préserver leur fidélité.

  • Analyser les vulnérabilités des systèmes d’apprentissage fédéré face aux attaques byzantines et aux attaques par empoisonnement, en particulier lorsque les stratégies adverses exploitent des métriques ou informations issues de l’explicabilité.

  • Étudier des scénarios d’attaque réalistes prenant en compte l’hétérogénéité et le déséquilibre des données détenues par les différents clients, l’empoisonnement des étiquettes (label poisoning) et la présence de clients associés à des attributs protégés.

  • Développer des algorithmes d’agrégation robustes et préservant la vie privée, capables de maintenir les performances du modèle dans des environnements comportant une proportion importante de participants malveillants.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de défense adaptatifs exploitant l’explicabilité, notamment pour identifier les comportements anormaux, les mises à jour suspectes ou les participants potentiellement malveillants.

  • Analyser conjointement les compromis entre vie privée, robustesse, explicabilité et utilité du modèle, en intégrant également les contraintes liées à l’efficacité computationnelle et aux communications.

  • Définir des protocoles et métriques d’évaluation permettant de comparer les approches proposées selon différents niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse, de fidélité des explications et de coût computationnel.

  • Expérimenter et évaluer les méthodes développées sur des scénarios réalistes d’apprentissage décentralisé, notamment dans le domaine de la santé et dans d’autres contextes traitant des données sensibles.

  • Contribuer à la validation expérimentale et à la valorisation des résultats, notamment par la mise en œuvre de prototypes, l’analyse des résultats, la rédaction de publications scientifiques et la présentation des travaux dans des événements scientifiques.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets
jobs.description:
Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre de projets stratégiques au sein d'un environnement pharmaceutique, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Assurance Qualité Projets – Qualification & Validation pour accompagner des projets de transfert entrant de produits en formes sèches et conditionnement.

Intégré au pôle Assurance Qualité Qualification, Validation & Projets, vous serez le représentant de l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble des activités Qualité associées aux projets, depuis la définition de la stratégie de qualification jusqu'à l'exécution des qualifications et au suivi du système qualité.

Vos missions :

  • Représenter l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets et garantir l'application des politiques de qualification pour les nouveaux équipements.
  • Définir et rédiger la documentation Qualité associée aux projets, notamment les besoins utilisateurs, cahiers des charges, plans directeurs de validation et rapports associés.
  • Piloter le système qualité à l'échelle des projets : Change Controls, CAPA, déviations et gestion documentaire.
  • Réaliser les analyses de criticité et analyses de risques relatives aux équipements et systèmes mis en place.
  • Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP, selon les besoins des projets.
  • Participer à l'exécution des qualifications sur le terrain, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Utilisateurs et Ingénierie.
  • Revoir et contribuer à la rédaction des procédures, modes opératoires et autres documents Qualité nécessaires à la mise en exploitation.
  • Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
  • Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets.
  • Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations.

Requirements

Chez Excelya, nous recherchons avant tout des professionnels rigoureux, autonomes et capables de collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.

  • Expérience : Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en Assurance Qualité et Qualification/Validation dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.
  • Expertise procédés : Vous possédez idéalement une expérience dans les procédés de formes sèches, notamment en extrusion, granulation sur LAF, compression et/ou conditionnement.
  • Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés.
  • Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP.
  • Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA, de l'Annexe 15 des EU GMP, du 21 CFR Part 11, des principes GAMP 5, ICH Q9 et ALCOA+.
  • Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent.
  • Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet.
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum, permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, permet à nos collaborateurs de développer leurs expertises aux côtés d'acteurs majeurs des Life Sciences.

En rejoignant cette mission, vous participerez directement à des projets de transferts de produits pharmaceutiques, avec un rôle central dans la maîtrise de la qualité, la qualification des équipements et la préparation des installations à leur exploitation.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Postulez dès aujourd'hui et devenez un Excelyate !

jobs.title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

jobs.title: ☀️️German-Speaking Customer Support Specialist-Relocate to Sunny Greece🇬🇷
jobs.description:
Ready for a Work-Life Upgrade under the Mediterranean Sun?

Imagine swapping cold commutes and grey skies for morning frappés, after-work dips in the Aegean, and weekends exploring island hideaways or ancient historic streets. If you speak German and have been dreaming of an exciting international fresh start, this is your sign!

At Next Job Abroad, we don't believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. We treat your job search like a personalized matching service. We partner with leading international customer experience hubs in Greece working with some of the world’s most recognized brands (think top-tier tech, e-commerce, gaming, travel, and automotive giants). Together, we make sure you land in a role that fits your background, strengths, and long-term goals.

What You’ll Be Doing (The Role)

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you will be the voice and face of global brands for German-speaking customers across Europe:

  • Be the Problem Solver: Assist customers via phone, live chat, and/or email with inquiries regarding products, order tracking, bookings, or account support.
  • Deliver Top-Class Service: Turn tricky situations into positive customer moments through clear, empathetic, and friendly communication.
  • Troubleshoot & Guide: Walk users through basic technical issues, service setups, or account features step-by-step.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work side-by-side with international colleagues in an inspiring, multicultural environment.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest brand features, tools, and updates with ongoing support.

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

What You'll Work On

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

  • Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare.

  • World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels.

  • Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains.

  • Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight.

This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built.

What You'll Work On

  • Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them.

  • Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab.

  • Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change.

  • Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you.

  • Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does.

  • Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test.

  • Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover.

  • Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers.

Who We're Looking For

A test, validation or reliability engineer who has shipped a product where failure had consequences, and who has seen what changes when a fleet goes from one unit to fifty. You treat simulation and CI as production infrastructure that you own, not tools you consume. You have judgment about what is worth testing: we want a safety net, not a wall of green ticks that hides the real risk. And you are comfortable being the person who says a build is not going out.

jobs.title: Brand Manager

About Flink

Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics.

We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it.

The role

You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome.

What you'll do

  • Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent.

  • Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed.

  • Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do.

  • Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels.

  • Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class.

  • Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable.

  • Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe.

  • Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink.

  • Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it.

What you bring

  • A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great.

  • Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things

  • Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media

  • A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count

  • Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build

  • First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count)

Nice to have

  • German (spoken or written)

  • Photo or video shooting and editing skills

  • Experience with website design

  • Interior design, set design or event production experience

  • Previous startup or tech-company experience

What we offer

  • The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise

  • Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one

  • Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world

  • A growing, ambitious team in Zürich

  • Competitive salary and employee stock options

  • Budget and freedom to try new ideas

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence.

At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence.

We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us.

The Role

You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role.

This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone.

What You Will Do

  • Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships.

  • Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps.

  • Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is.

  • Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks.

  • Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes.

  • Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination.

Who You Are

  • A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle.

  • Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched.

  • Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers.

  • A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity.

  • High ownership and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others.

  • Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out.

  • Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck.

  • A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too: Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering.

  • Hands-on experience at an early-stage startup that is still building, still raising — or founder experience — is a strong plus over scale-up experience.

Requirements

  • Zurich-based strongly preferred - either current location or planning to relocate.

  • Frequent short-notice travel to the UK, Nordics, US, and Asia.

  • Comfortable operating at high speed with fast decision cycles.

  • Professional experience, relationships or network relevant to Jua's industry and customer base preferred.

At Jua, we foster a performance culture and value people who embody our beliefs of service and adventure. We prioritize agility, operating at the highest clock speed to adapt quickly to change.

We innovate on behalf of our users and leverage data supremacy to maintain our competitive edge. Through clear communication and fact-based decision-making, we ensure alignment in our pursuit of excellence.

With these principles, we aim to create a customer-focused, value-centric organization that sets new standards in the industry. We value the unique perspectives that each individual brings to the table and believe that embracing diverse backgrounds and experiences enriches our collective journey towards growth and success.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

jobs.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
jobs.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
jobs.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior SEO & Organic Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

  • Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact
  • Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders
  • Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape
  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise
  • Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

  • Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations
  • Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities
  • Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly
  • Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights
  • Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions
  • Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search
  • Embrace our core values:
    • Give a Sh!t
    • Always Be in It To Win It
    • Be Obsessed with Serving Others
    • Practice a Growth Mindset
    • When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

  • Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals
  • Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations
  • Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions
  • Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations
  • Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence
  • Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask
  • Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

  • Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization
  • Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance
  • Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels
  • Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights
  • Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies
  • Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS
  • Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution
  • Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients
  • Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement
  • Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates
  • Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities
  • Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations
  • You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations
  • You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions
  • Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations
  • You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation
  • Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses
  • 5 weeks of paid time off
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones
  • Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents
  • Regular team meetups and annual retreats
  • Clear career progression path without requiring a management track
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

  • Working with top 1% SaaS experts
  • Supportive and empathetic leadership
  • End-to-end control with no account manager involvement
  • Highly data-driven and results-oriented
  • Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours
  • Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks
  • Regular professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Dental - International
jobs.location: Internationally located (not in the US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)
jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Account Manager will be instrumental in helping grow and retain Clipboard's existing markets. Healthcare providers are core to the Clipboard marketplace — the Account Manager is in charge of nurturing and expanding relationships with current users, going deep with those users to understand their needs, and ensuring they're consistently successful on the platform. There's no ceiling to what you can achieve in this role — if you're highly motivated to go above and beyond, a diligent executor, and a strong written/verbal communicator, Clipboard is the place for you to excel.

Responsibilities

  • Managing and growing relationships with an existing portfolio of healthcare providers and dental offices

  • Clearly articulating the value proposition of the app to current users to drive continued engagement and expansion

  • Going deep with healthcare providers and dental offices to uncover their evolving needs, understand their challenges, and find ways to genuinely help them succeed on the platform

  • Establishing credibility and rapport with providers, which includes demonstrating a strong understanding of the app

  • Being the go-to point of contact for users that need help navigating the app, resolving issues, and getting the most out of the platform

  • Helping fill new and urgent shifts in your assigned markets

Qualifications

  • Willingness to hustle / lack of fear

  • Experience texting, emailing, and talking with English-speaking clients and prospects

Requirements

  • Stable high-speed internet connection

  • A computer workstation (laptop or desktop)

  • Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

  • Availability to work US working hours

  • Fluency in English speaking and writing

Beyond the Basics — What Will Make You Successful

  • Noticing & Curiosity — You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. You dig to understand the root of a problem or situation rather than accepting things at face value, and you're constantly updating your understanding of the customers you serve.

  • Initiative & Persistence — You have a bias for action. You know that our customers are dealing with real problems today, and you don't wait for perfect information before making a move. You're scrappy and self-reliant, you find ways through obstacles rather than around them, and you bring solutions instead of asking "what should I do?"

  • Ownership — The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You take full responsibility for your results, fix problems when you see them — even outside your immediate area — and put processes in place to make sure those problems don't happen again.

  • Customer-Centric — You feel your customers' situations genuinely and care about improving their lives, not just hitting a number. Talking to customers and solving their problems isn't a task on your list — it's the job.

  • Humble — You're low ego and care about getting to the best outcome, not about being right. You readily admit when you don't know something, you actively seek out feedback, and you're always looking to become a better version of yourself.

Benefits

  • Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

  • Competitive pay

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully Remote

Estimated annual compensation: $12,000–$15,600 USD. Each candidate's compensation offer within this range will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Product Lead (Strategy + Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide
  • 🧰 All the AI and tools you need to do your best work
  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product roadmap across our platforms — prioritize, spec, and drive execution from idea to launch
  • Build and ship features hands-on alongside our web developer, improving site architecture, performance, and conversion flows
  • Lead and grow the product team — manage team members, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and take part in recruitment as we scale
  • Build our engineering workflow — set up development routines, code review, testing and deployment processes so multiple developers can ship safely, with documentation so knowledge is never siloed
  • Make data-first decisions — turn user data, market insights, and analytics into actions that move traffic, conversion, and revenue per visitor

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of full stack development experience — you can independently build, deploy, and maintain production web applications, and set up the workflows (Git, code review, CI/CD) for your team to do the same
  • A track record you can show — live products, sites, or projects you’ve built or led, and the ability to walk us through the decisions behind them
  • Strong backend, database, and architecture skills — data accuracy is critical to us, as we track and report statistics to 450+ partners
  • Proven product ownership with commercial instincts — you’ve decided what to build, not just built what was decided, and you understand how those decisions translate into revenue
  • Independent and async-first — you drive your own work in a small remote team and document decisions clearly in writing
  • Genuine interest in cryptocurrencies, investing, and personal finance — and high standards for what a great comparison platform looks like

Tech Stack:

  • Backend: PHP 8.2+ / Laravel 12 — one codebase powering the public sites and our in-house admin CMS/API
  • Frontend: Server-rendered Laravel Blade with Alpine.js, Livewire (admin), Tailwind CSS, and Vite — no React/Next.js
  • Database: MySQL, with Redis for cache, queues, and realtime (Laravel Reverb)
  • Infrastructure: Linux VPS with Nginx and PHP-FPM, automated deploys via GitHub Actions
  • Integrations: AI models via multiple providers (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) plus third-party API integrations powering our platforms and admin system

Our Team Values:

  • Full Ownership – If you see it, you own it. Take full ownership from start to finish.
  • Data First – Data first, decision second. Always put data first before making decisions.
  • Long Game – We are building for decades, not quarters. Always play the long game.
  • AI Speed – The fastest teams win. Use AI to move like a team ten times our size.

Location & Availability:

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates should be able to maintain reasonable overlap with European business hours (CET/CEST) for meetings and team collaboration. We welcome applications from candidates worldwide, except residents of the United States.

Compensation:

USD 48,000–90,000 gross per year, consisting of a fixed base salary (USD 48,000–60,000, based on experience) and a revenue-tied performance bonus. You’ll receive paid time off and public holidays in line with the standards of your country of employment. Additional benefits and reimbursements may apply depending on your location. We employ through a global HR partner, enabling compliant employment in 95+ countries.

Apply:

Send in your application here: https://forms.gle/4yqiWvhiCMnC6xdx7

Hiring process: 1-minute intro video → intro call with the founder → portfolio walkthrough → offer. Applications reviewed continuously, start date by agreement.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

  • 5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

  • Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

  • Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

  • Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

  • Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

  • Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

  • Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

  • Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

  • Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

  • Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will review AI generated responses and decide which ones actually hold up: accurate, relevant, concise, safe, well localized, and true to what the user asked for. Every ranking comes with a short written rationale, and those comments feed directly into how the models improve.

Careful reading and good judgment matter far more than speed here.

What you will do

  • Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted

  • Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria

  • Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing

What you bring

  • Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases

  • Solid research skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent reading comprehension

  • Professional written English that is clear and concise

  • Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision

Prior experience in AI evaluation, annotation, writing, editing, research, or translation is a plus, though not required.

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.
